patch.title: 统一英文问卷表达（Q1 补充 with the service，与 Q2 平行），并同步 methods.tex 中的题号（Q1/Q2）与量表锚点描述。

hunks.oldText:
Q1. How satisfied are you?
Options: 1 = Very dissatisfied; 2 = Dissatisfied; 3 = Neutral; 4 = Satisfied; 5 = Very satisfied.
hunks.newText:
Q1. How satisfied are you with the service?
Options: 1 = Very dissatisfied; 2 = Dissatisfied; 3 = Neutral; 4 = Satisfied; 5 = Very satisfied.

hunks.oldText: We used a five-level scale and analyzed Question 1 and Question 2.
hunks.newText: We used a five-level scale and analyzed Q1 (satisfaction: 1 = Very dissatisfied to 5 = Very satisfied) and Q2 (likelihood of recommendation: 1 = Definitely no to 5 = Definitely yes).
